_note: Affinities a prime vestige can carry (design/01: a prime delivers a talent and 1+ affinities; more affinities is rarer and worth more). Brent 2026-10-11: fire, earth, wind and lightning beside water. Affinities are NOT tied to the talent - they decide which skills you can learn and are rolled separately when a prime is offered (see balance.json 'primes' and PrimeRoll). prime_default is only what a character gets when nothing was rolled (tests, bots, old saves). 'kit' is the three abilities a character with that affinity starts with: a ranged attack, a melee strike, a movement skill. Labels, descriptions and kits are ours [MODEL].

water.label: Water
water.desc: Pressure, flow and weight. Strikes that hit like a wave and movement that slips past a guard.

fire.label: Fire
fire.desc: Quick, cheap and hungry. It asks little essence and leaves a great deal of heat behind.

earth.label: Earth
earth.desc: Slow, heavy and sure. Nothing arrives fast, and nothing it hits stays standing.

wind.label: Wind
wind.desc: Light and far-reaching. Small costs, long reach, and you are never where you were.

lightning.label: Lightning
lightning.desc: All at once or not at all. Short, violent and expensive.
